exemptions.reason: These controls grant capabilities or persist human audio. Flipt has no authentication, so moving them would widen authorization without a lifecycle redesign.
These controls select startup wiring or fatal asset and credential paths. Runtime evaluation cannot safely replace their boot lifecycle.
Observability initialization is boot-scoped and must not disappear behind an unauthenticated runtime toggle.
CI and automation deciders must remain explicit environment or workflow controls, not remotely mutable product flags.
The service needs these values before a flag provider can initialize, so they cannot be sourced from Flipt.
